verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0 client credentials, an interactive playground, and LLM-friendly Markdown/llms.txt docs. No evidence mentions any official SDK or client library, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Official SDKs are a fair question for an API-first fintech, so the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
